method.seasons: 2006-2025 regular seasons (20 seasons, 19 season pairs); per-snap and per-route rates 2016-2025 (nflverse participation); FTN fields 2022-2025; NGS 2016-2025; 2026 in progress, excluded
method.yoy: Pearson r between seasons t and t+1 of the published payload value (players.json / value.json), z-scored within season and peer group, qualified in both seasons; play-level recomputation where the field is not in the payload
method.split_half: odd v even games of the player's season (uncorrected r on within-season z-scores, pooled over seasons; split_half_r_sb = 2r/(1+r)); recomputed from nflverse play-by-play with our out-of-fold RYOE and xYAC and nflfastR cp (our completion model is not stored per play)
method.m50: n_bar x (1 - r) / r with r the uncorrected split-half r at the mean half-season sample n_bar; where no split exists, the year-to-year r at the mean season sample (an upper bound). Counting stats and model composites have no m50.
method.predictive: Pearson r of the metric in season t with the target in season t+1, same peer group, both qualified, sign oriented so positive = the metric's better direction goes with a better future target. QB: next-season EPA per dropback (r2: next-season Gridiron Value per game). RB: next-season RYOE per carry (r2: next-season EPA per carry). WR/TE: next-season EPA per target (r2: next-season yards per route run, 2016-2025). EDGE/IDL: next-season sacks + QB hits per pass snap (r2: Splash EPA per snap). LB: next-season splash plays per snap. CB/S: next-season passes defensed + INT per pass snap. K: next-season FG over expected per attempt (distance curve). P: next-season EPA per punt (r2: net average). Teams: first-half metric v second-half win% and point differential per game; season t v t+1 win% and point differential (payload values).
method.peer_groups: WR and TE are separate (Cohen's d WR v TE: aDOT 1.58, air share 1.62, yards per team attempt 0.93, target share 0.91; 45% of qualified TEs fall below the pooled 25th percentile of yards per team attempt). Defence uses five roles (EDGE, IDL, LB, CB, S) from value.json pos: in the payload's DL/LB/DB scheme 523 of 1,051 snap-qualified edge rushers sit in LB, where their sacks + hits per pass snap (5.1%) is four times an off-ball linebacker's (1.2%).

benchmarks.qb: next-season EPA/dropback autocorrelation 0.409 (447 pairs); QB composite predicts it at 0.458
benchmarks.wr: EPA/target autocorrelation 0.205 (1,134 pairs); yards per route run 0.523 (523 pairs)
benchmarks.te: EPA/target autocorrelation 0.218 (547 pairs); yards per route run 0.551 (245 pairs)
benchmarks.edge: sacks + hits per pass snap autocorrelation 0.428 (681 pairs)
benchmarks.cb: PD + INT per pass snap 0.255 (673 pairs)
benchmarks.k: FG over expected per attempt 0.039 (507 pairs)
benchmarks.teams: first-half point differential/game -> second-half win% 0.465, point diff 0.516; net EPA/play -> 0.453 / 0.513 (640 team-halves)

composite.name: QB composite
composite.about: Our all-round passing grade: EPA per dropback, accuracy, sack avoidance and turnovers blended into a forecast of next season's EPA per dropback.

value.name: Gridiron Value (GVAR)
value.about: Our value above a replacement-level player at the same position, per game and in total, from the plays the player is credited with.

kicking.name: Expected kicking model
kicking.about: Field goals, points and net punting over what an average kicker or punter would manage on the same attempts.

fourth.name: Fourth-down model
fourth.about: Our go / kick / punt advice from the win-probability model, and how often a team goes when it says go.

team.name: Team rating model
team.about: Points per game better than average, split into offence and defence, from our game model.
